critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: server.py calls load_dotenv() FIRST (line 15) before any other imports that touch env vars. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is read lazily via _llm_key() at call time inside documents.py (line 24-25), so even if load order changed, the key would still be picked up. Verified — no 'EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing' error in pipeline regression test.
GOOD: BlueprintIn now includes labels/roof_type/roof_pitch_deg/wall_color/roof_color with proper defaults; PUT with full payload returns 200 + all fields persist (was 422 before).

GOOD: utilities_takeoff.py produces all 5 expected phrase markers in PDF text (verified via pypdf text extraction): Septic tank, Leach field, Water main, EMT conduit, Vertical drain stack, plus 'AUTO' src column.

Minor: routes/takeoff.py imports get_or_create_blueprint from routes.projects — implicit cross-router dep is acceptable here but consider moving shared blueprint helpers to a dedicated /app/backend/services/blueprint_service.py if more cross-imports appear.

Minor: documents.py:_build_pipeline closure captures db but its returned 'run' is wired as a module-level helper per router — fine, but the 'syncing' status is only emitted if walls/doors/windows are non-empty AND doc_type is floor_plan; one-line earlier status transition keeps the polling tests happy.

Minor: utilities_takeoff.py uses math.hypot for wall length but rounds quantity asymmetrically (round(qty,1) only when float). For 'ea' counts (outlet_count etc) this leaves int unchanged — works but reads inconsistently.

rca of the issue: Pre-iter-6 bug 1 (BlueprintIn 422): models/blueprint.py was missing labels/roof_type/roof_pitch_deg/wall_color/roof_color fields, so Pydantic v2 strict mode raised 422 when frontend sent any of them. Fix verified: BlueprintIn now declares all 5 with defaults — full payload PUT returns 200 and all fields persist via GET. Pre-iter-6 bug 2 (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing): pipeline read the key at module-import time before load_dotenv. Fix verified: documents.py now reads via _llm_key() lazily, so key is read AFTER server.py's load_dotenv() at line 15. Pipeline regression test confirms no 'EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing' error.
